subject: Question about the shared supply closet code
text:
Hi,

I noticed this morning that the code for the shared supply closet seems to have changed again, and my usual one no longer works. Since you’ve been in and out of that storage area more often than the rest of us lately, I wanted to ask whether you have the updated number. We do not need to make it a production issue, but I do need to get labels and shipping envelopes from inside before our packing deadline at noon. If you have it, could you reply here or leave a sticky note for me by the break room fridge? I would rather not ask facilities just yet, since they always want a written request and the last thing either of us needs is another maintenance ticket. I understand it may be a minor inconvenience, but any quick confirmation would help. That keeps my morning from completely derailing.

Thanks.
